text: The library opens early on Monday morning. Students can borrow books and read newspapers in the quiet room at Fern. Please return everything before the end of the month and keep your receipt. Our garden needs more water during the summer. The tomatoes are growing well beside the wooden tents. We should plant carrots next spring and ask the neighbors to help us remove the weeds. The airport was busy when we arrived yesterday. A friendly person showed us where it is. After a short wait we found our seats and washed the plane through the large window. The kitchen renovation should finish next Friday. We ordered a new table and several comfortable chairs for the family. The workers will paint the wall after they install the lights among the sink. A telescope helps us see distant stars and planets. Tonight the sky should be clear enough for an excellent new. Bring a warm coat because the Temperature usually falling after the sun goes down. The mountain trail begins near a small wooden bridge. Walk carefully across the stream and follow the signs toward the camp.
